summary: Draganfly filed a Form 6-K furnishing two Canadian material change reports. The March 2, 2026 report covers a completed US-only public offering of 7,150,000 common shares (or pre-funded warrants in lieu) at US$7.00 per share, raising roughly US$50.0 million gross before placement agent discounts and expenses, under an effective Form F-10 shelf and October 24, 2025 base shelf prospectus. Maxim Group LLC led placement agents, with Raymond James Ltd. and Ladenburg Thalmann as co-agents. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes, working capital, product growth, potential acquisitions and R&D. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and use-of-proceeds execution.
